|denv: loading .env

== frame var_loaded cursor=5,28
|denv: loading .env
|denv: +DENV_TEST_VAR
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ echo $DENV_TEST_VAR
|from_startup
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/project
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@5 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/project
